title: Unit 1 第二课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: 一、用所给词的适当形式填空 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列句子，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。

questions.prompt:
1. —______ he your brother?
—No, he ______. He's my friend.
questions.translation:
——他是你哥哥吗？
——不，他不是。他是我的朋友。
questions.explanation: 主语he为第三人称单数，问句be动词用Is；否定简略回答用“No, he isn't.”。故选 Is; isn't。
问句主语you用Are提问；以第一人称否定回答时用“No, I'm not.”。故选 Are; 'm not。

questions.prompt: 3. My name ______ Lingling. Their names ______ Emma and David.
questions.translation: 我的名字叫玲玲。他们的名字叫艾玛和戴维。
questions.explanation: 第一空主语My name为单数，be动词用is；第二空主语Their names为复数，be动词用are。故选 is; are。

questions.prompt: 4. This ______ Lucy. That ______ Lily. They ______ twins.
questions.translation: 这是露西。那是莉莉。她们是双胞胎。
questions.explanation: This和That作主语时be动词用单数is；They作主语时be动词用复数are。故选 is; is; are。

questions.prompt:
5. —What's your last name?
—Green. You can call ______ Mr. Green.
questions.translation:
——你姓什么？
——格林。你可以叫我格林先生。
questions.explanation: 动词call后面作宾语，应用第一人称宾格代词me。故选 me。

questions.translation: 巴里非常喜欢中国食物。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词food应用形容词Chinese（中国的）。故选 Chinese。
修饰名词room应用形容词性物主代词our（我们的）。故选 our。

questions.prompt: 8. Sunday is the ______ day of a week.
questions.translation: 星期天是一周的第一天。
questions.explanation: 定冠词the后接序数词表示第几天，one的序数词为first。故选 first。
修饰名词name应用第二人称形容词性物主代词your。故选 your。
修饰名词短语English name应用女性形容词性物主代词Her。句首首字母大写。故选 Her。

sections.title: 二、辨析填空 (also 与 too)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列句子，根据句意选用 also 或 too 填空。

questions.prompt: 1. He is a musician. His father is a musician ______.
questions.translation: 他是一名音乐家。他的父亲也是一名音乐家。
questions.explanation: too常用于肯定句句末表示“也”，前面通常有或无逗号隔开；also通常用于肯定句句中（be动词后、实义动词前）。故选 too。

questions.prompt: 2. Cindy is an English girl and I'm ______ an English girl.
questions.translation: 辛迪是一个英国女孩，我也是一个英国女孩。
questions.explanation: 空缺处位于be动词am之后、句中位置，表示“也”应用also。故选 also。

questions.prompt: 3. Lisa is good at drawing flowers. Her sister does well in it ______.
questions.translation: 丽萨擅长画花。她姐姐在画花方面也做得很好。
questions.explanation: 空缺处位于肯定句句末，表示“也”应用too。故选 too。

questions.prompt: 4. I was in Mr. Wang's class, and Mike was ______ in it at that time.
questions.translation: 我在王老师的班上，迈克那时也在那个班上。
questions.explanation: 空缺处位于be动词was之后、句中位置，表示“也”应用also。故选 also。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Look! The girl looks like a Barbie doll (芭比娃娃). She has long blond hair. Her blue eyes are big, but her mouth and nose are small. She is a nice girl. Who is she?

Oh, she is Sally. She is from England. She is thirteen years old. Her mom and dad are English. Both of them are in Beijing now. Her mom is my English teacher. She and I are good friends. Well, green is Sally's favourite colour, and she is in green. We are in the same school, but we are in different classes.

questions.translation: 她的眼睛是什么颜色的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中的“Her blue eyes are big...”可知，她的眼睛是蓝色的。故选 Blue.。
根据第二段中的“Her mom and dad are English. Both of them are in Beijing now.”可知，她的父母现在都在北京（中国）。故选 In China.。
look like是固定短语，意为“看起来像”。故选 看起来像。

questions.translation: 萨莉最喜欢的颜色是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段中的“Well, green is Sally's favourite colour...”可知，萨莉最喜欢绿色。故选 Green.。

options: Sally and I are in the same class.
questions.explanation: 根据最后一句“We are in the same school, but we are in different classes.”可知，她们在不同的班级，因此“Sally and I are in the same class”表述错误。故选 Sally and I are in the same class.。

sections.title: 四、完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
My name is Tom Smith. Tom is my [1] name. I am 13 years old. Now I'm [2] middle school student. I'm [3] Class One, Grade Seven. My class teacher is [4] Gao. We all like him. He is a very [5] teacher. And he is also [6] English teacher. He always says "Hello" [7] class and he is kind to everyone.

I have a friend at school. His name [8] Zhang Lin. He is a tall boy and he is 13, too. He is in Class Two, Grade Seven. I like blue a lot, but Zhang Lin likes [9]. He thinks black is cool.

Do you want to [10] friends with us?

questions.explanation: 在姓名Tom Smith中，Tom是名字（first name），Smith是姓氏。故选 first。
middle school student为单数可数名词短语，middle以辅音音素开头，表示泛指用不定冠词a。故选 a。
表示在某个班级用介词in，be in Class One, Grade Seven。故选 in。

questions.translation: 我的班主任是高老师。我们都喜欢他。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“We all like him. He is a very...”中代词him/he可知班主任是男性，称呼用Mr.。故选 Mr.。

questions.translation: 他是一位非常优秀的老师。
questions.explanation: 根据上文“We all like him”以及后文“kind to everyone”可知，他是一位好老师（good teacher）。故选 good。
叙述者以第一人称介绍自己的老师，修饰English teacher用my。故选 my。

questions.translation: 他在上课前总是打招呼说“Hello”。
questions.explanation: before class意为“上课前”，老师上课前向大家问好符合日常情理。故选 before。
主语His name为单数名词短语，be动词用is。故选 is。

questions.translation: 我很喜欢蓝色，但张林喜欢黑色。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“He thinks black is cool.”可知张林喜欢黑色（black）。故选 black。
make friends with sb. 为固定搭配，意为“与某人交朋友”。故选 make。

sections.title: 五、语篇填空 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案填入空白处。
sections.passage: Hello, my name is Li Hui. I am a [1] boy. I am [2] Shanghai now. I'm 13 [3] old. I am in Class 5, Grade 7. Tom is [4] good friend. He is [5] English boy. He is 13 years old [6]. His [7] name is Tom, [8] his Chinese name is Dalin. He [9] in Shanghai, China now. He is in Class 6, Grade 7. He likes Chinese food a lot. [10] favourite food is hot pot.

questions.explanation: 修饰名词boy应用形容词Chinese（中国的）。故选 Chinese。
在大城市前面用介词in，be in Shanghai表示“在上海”。故选 in。
基数词13大于1，名词year应用复数形式years。故选 years。
修饰名词短语good friend应用形容词性物主代词my（我的）。故选 my。
English以元音音素开头，泛指一个用不定冠词an。故选 an。
肯定句句末表示“也”，应用副词too。故选 too。
修饰名词name应用形容词English，English name意为“英文名字”。故选 English。

questions.translation: 但是他的中文名字叫大林。
questions.explanation: 英文名字和中文名字前后形成转折对比，用连词but。故选 but。
主语He为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词live需加s变为lives。故选 lives。

questions.translation: 他最喜爱的食物是火锅。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语favourite food应用形容词性物主代词His。句首首字母大写。故选 His。

sections.title: 六、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读布告栏信息，从每小题所给的 A、B、C 三个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
| GREENWOOD COMMUNITY CENTER NOTICEBOARD | JULY | |---|---| | **LEARN TO MAKE BREAD AND CAKES WITH ANNE**

Time: 2-4 p.m., 15th July.
Place: Anne's kitchen, Main Street.
All ages welcome.
£8 for ingredients | **♫ DANCERCISE!**

Have fun and do dancercise to jazz and hip pop music at 6-8 p.m. every Tuesday
Place: Molly's studio, 32 Green Road.
All ages welcome.
Cost: £70/month. £20/class | | **Story time with Cathy**

All your favourite children's stories told by actress Cathy Wells
**FREE**
When? 3-5 p.m., 23rd July
Where? Greenwood Public Library
6 to 9-year-olds and parents | |

questions.prompt: 1. When can people learn to make bread and cakes?
questions.translation: 人们什么时候可以学习做面包和蛋糕？
questions.explanation: 根据第一栏“Time: 2-4 p.m., 15th July.”可知，做面包蛋糕的时间是7月15日。故选 On July 15th.。

questions.prompt: 2. What is the cost of dancercise classes for a month?
questions.translation: 健美操课一个月的费用是多少？
questions.explanation: 根据第二栏“Cost: £70/month. £20/class”可知，一个月的费用是70英镑。故选 £70.。
根据第三栏“Story time with Cathy ... told by actress Cathy Wells”可知，讲故事的是Cathy。故选 Cathy.。

questions.prompt: 4. What are the three texts above?
questions.explanation: 根据标题“COMMUNITY CENTER NOTICEBOARD”以及内容介绍课程时间、地点、费用等可知，这些都是广告（Advertisements）。故选 Advertisements.。
